Remark
[Extending $\delta ^*$ beyond the compact case] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0296 1. Section A.2\group first-order-differential-operators-on-tensors

The formula $\delta ^*\theta =\tfrac 12 \Lie _{\theta ^\sharp }g$ can be used to define $\delta ^*$ even when $\mathcal M^n$ is not compact.
